title: 2025/2026 Hawaii Green Business Awards Program Honors Local Businesses and Events for Sustainability Practices
summary: Hawaii State Energy Office — The Hawaii Green Business Program recognized 51 Hawaii businesses and events last night for their commitment to energy and water efficiency, waste reduction, pollution prevention and community involvement, as well as cultural and natural resource preservation.
author: David Hiromoto
